newsitem.title: CANADA: Gulfstream says Qatar oil production began.
newsitem.headline: Gulfstream says Qatar oil production began.

text.p: Gulfstream Resources Canada Ltd, which has a stake in the ARCO Qatar oil consortium, said on Thursday that crude production had started at Qatar's Al-Rayyan field.
Gulfstream said it made the statement at the request of the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Its shares jumped C$1.25 to C$12.10 on Thursday, climbing from C$8.55 on October 25.

The ARCO consortium embraces operator Atlantic Richfield Co with 27.5 percent, Gulfstream with 27.5 percent, British Gas Plc with 25 percent, Wintershall with 15 percent and Preussag Energie with 5.0 percent.
The field, located 156 km north of the Qatari capital Doha, is expected to produce 30,000 barrels per day initially, with output climbing to 50,000 bpd in four years.
"The consortium is looking forward to full production in the near term, and Gulfstream expects that a press release will be made at that time," the company said.
Gulfstream said its executives made presentations to institutional investors Thursday in Toronto but no new information was presented. -- Reuters Calgary Bureau 403 531-1624
